units.text: Given one or more patterns, ⟦0⟧ searches input files for matches to the patterns. When it finds a match in a line, it copies the line to standard output (by default), or produces whatever other sort of output you have requested with options.
units.sourceHTML: Given one or more patterns, grep searches input files for matches to the patterns. When it finds a match in a line, it copies the line to standard output (by default), or produces whatever other sort of output you have requested with options.

units.text: Though ⟦0⟧ expects to do the matching on text, it has no limits on input line length other than available memory, and it can match arbitrary characters within a line. If the final byte of an input file is not a newline, ⟦1⟧ silently supplies one. Since newline is also a separator for the list of patterns, there is no way to match newline characters in a text.
